decisions.reason: The necessary cross-Requirement effect is already fully represented by the candidate's message-116 MODIFY requiring the lowercase closing v to carry the Hero V's right-arm gesture.

The candidate already has a message-116 MODIFY capturing the selected Hero V reference and the required confidence of the right arm's final section; the accent derivation decision does not require another Hero V attribute change.
The source concerns the shared right-arm gesture across the capital V, lowercase v, and É accent, not the deferred architectural construction of the E and L letterforms.
The geometric relationship between the Hero V and É accent does not alter the deferred champagne-metal material direction or its application constraint.
Viewing the three signature forms together does not change the deferred kerning, spacing, or cohesive-reading requirements.
The source provides design feedback about the signature forms but does not change the separate obligation to include rationale with each design round.
The source decision does not affect accepted review-image formats or preview accessibility.
The source refines the relationship among signature letterforms without changing the final production-ready artwork handoff requirement.
